takeaways.en: PL-300 earns the Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification.
takeaways.zh: 通过 PL-300 可获得「Microsoft Certified: Power BI 数据分析师助理」认证。

takeaways.en: Four skill areas: Prepare the data, Model the data, Visualize and analyze the data (25–30% each) and Manage and secure Power BI (15–20%).
takeaways.zh: 四个技能领域：准备数据、数据建模、可视化与分析数据（各占 25–30%），以及管理和保护 Power BI（15–20%）。

takeaways.en: You need 700 out of 1000 to pass; the certification is renewed once a year with a free online assessment.
takeaways.zh: 需要 1000 分中的 700 分才能通过；认证每年通过一次免费的在线评估续期。

html.en: PL-300 is the exam behind the Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification. It tests whether you can take raw data and turn it into a trustworthy Power BI solution: connect and clean the data, build a semantic model with DAX, design reports that people can use, and publish and secure the result in the Power BI service.
html.zh: PL-300 是 Microsoft Certified: Power BI 数据分析师助理认证的考试。它考的是你能否把原始数据变成可信的 Power BI 解决方案：连接并清理数据、用 DAX 建立语义模型、设计好用的报表，并在 Power BI 服务中发布和保护成果。

caption.zh: 考试技能（Microsoft PL-300 学习指南）

items.en: Passing score: 700 on a scale of 1–1000. The score is scaled, so 700 is not simply 70% of the questions.
items.zh: 及格分数：1–1000 分制中的 700 分。分数经过换算，所以 700 分并不等于答对 70% 的题目。

items.en: About 100 minutes of answering time. Expect roughly 40–60 questions; Microsoft does not publish a fixed number.
items.zh: 作答时间约 100 分钟。题目大约 40–60 题，Microsoft 不公布固定题数。

items.en: Question styles include single and multiple choice, drag-and-drop, build-a-list, "Yes/No" statement series and case studies with several questions about one scenario.
items.zh: 题型包括单选、多选、拖放、排序（build a list）、一组「是/否」陈述，以及围绕同一情境出好几题的案例分析。

items.en: During the exam you may open Microsoft Learn in a restricted window; it does not add time, so it helps only for quick lookups.
items.zh: 考试期间可以在受限窗口中打开 Microsoft Learn 查资料，但不会延长时间，只适合快速查一下。

items.en: The certification is valid for one year. Renew it for free with an online assessment on Microsoft Learn in the six months before it expires.
items.zh: 认证有效期一年。在到期前六个月内，可在 Microsoft Learn 上免费完成在线评估来续期。

html.en: Details such as the price, the time and the question types change. Check Microsoft's exam page before you book.
html.zh: 价格、时间和题型等细节会变。报名前请再看一次 Microsoft 的官方考试页面。

html.en: Microsoft offers a free practice assessment for PL-300 on the certification page. Use it together with the mock exam in this app: the app's questions are written for study, not copied from the real exam.
html.zh: Microsoft 在认证页面提供免费的 PL-300 练习评估。把它和本 App 的模拟考试一起用：本 App 的题目是为学习而写的，不是真题。

q.en: Which skill area carries the smallest share of the PL-300 exam?
q.zh: PL-300 考试中，哪个技能领域所占比重最小？

why.en: Right: 15–20%, the other three are 25–30% each.

heading.en: What Power BI is made of

takeaways.en: Power BI Desktop is the free Windows app where you build the semantic model and the report.
takeaways.zh: Power BI Desktop 是免费的 Windows 应用，用来建立语义模型和报表。

takeaways.en: The Power BI service (app.powerbi.com) is where you publish, share, refresh and secure content.
takeaways.zh: Power BI 服务（app.powerbi.com）用来发布、分享、刷新和保护内容。

takeaways.en: A semantic model (formerly called a dataset) holds the tables, relationships and measures that reports use.
takeaways.zh: 语义模型（以前叫「数据集」）包含报表使用的表、关系和度量值。

html.en: Power BI is a family of tools that work together. The exam expects you to know which tool does which job.
html.zh: Power BI 是一组互相配合的工具。考试要求你知道哪个工具负责什么工作。

rows.en: Connect to data, transform it in Power Query, build the model and DAX, design report pages. Free, Windows only.
rows.zh: 连接数据、在 Power Query 中转换、建立模型和 DAX、设计报表页面。免费，仅限 Windows。

rows.en: Cloud (SaaS) at app.powerbi.com: workspaces, apps, dashboards, scheduled refresh, sharing, security. Part of Microsoft Fabric.
rows.zh: 云端（SaaS），网址 app.powerbi.com：工作区、应用、仪表板、计划刷新、分享和安全。属于 Microsoft Fabric 的一部分。

rows.en: Apps for iOS and Android to view reports and dashboards.
rows.zh: iOS 和 Android 应用，用来查看报表和仪表板。

rows.en: Authoring tool for paginated (pixel-perfect, printable) reports.
rows.zh: 用来制作分页报表（像素级精确、适合打印）的工具。

rows.en: On-premises server for organisations that cannot use the cloud.
rows.zh: 供不能使用云端的组织在本地部署的服务器。

items.en: Semantic model: tables, relationships, measures and security. Renamed from "dataset" in 2023, so older material still says dataset.
items.zh: 语义模型：表、关系、度量值和安全设置。2023 年由「数据集」改名，所以旧资料仍写「数据集」。

items.en: Report: one or more pages of visuals built on one semantic model.
items.zh: 报表：基于一个语义模型的一页或多页视觉对象。

items.en: Dashboard: a single canvas in the service made of tiles pinned from reports; it can combine several reports.
items.zh: 仪表板：服务中的单一画布，由从报表固定（pin）的磁贴组成，可以汇集多份报表。

items.en: Workspace: a container in the service where a team keeps and works on its items.
items.zh: 工作区：服务中的容器，团队在里面存放和协作处理内容。

items.en: App: a packaged, read-only view of a workspace's content for a wider audience.
items.zh: 应用（App）：把工作区内容打包成只读版本，分发给更多读者。

rows.en: Use Desktop and your own My workspace; view content only if it sits in a Premium or Fabric F64+ capacity.
rows.zh: 使用 Desktop 和自己的「我的工作区」；只有内容位于 Premium 或 Fabric F64 以上容量时才能查看别人分享的内容。

rows.en: Publish to shared workspaces, share and collaborate. Both the author and the viewer need Pro (or PPU) unless the content is in a capacity.
rows.zh: 发布到共享工作区、分享和协作。除非内容放在容量中，否则作者和读者都需要 Pro（或 PPU）。

rows.en: Pro features plus Premium features (larger models, more refreshes, paginated reports, deployment pipelines) for licensed users.
rows.zh: Pro 的功能加上 Premium 功能（更大的模型、更多刷新次数、分页报表、部署管道），仅限有授权的用户。

rows.en: The organisation buys compute; from F64 up, free users can view content in that capacity.
rows.zh: 组织购买计算资源；从 F64 起，免费用户也可以查看该容量中的内容。

html.en: A classic question: users with a free licence cannot see a report shared with them. The fix is either Pro licences for them or moving the workspace to a Premium/Fabric F64+ capacity.
html.zh: 经典考题：免费授权的用户看不到分享给他们的报表。解决办法是给他们 Pro 授权，或者把工作区移到 Premium/Fabric F64 以上的容量。

q.en: You need to build a semantic model with relationships and DAX measures. Which tool do you use?
q.zh: 你要建立一个包含关系和 DAX 度量值的语义模型，应该用哪个工具？

why.en: Desktop is the main authoring tool for models and reports.
why.zh: Desktop 是建立模型和报表的主要工具。

why.en: Dashboards display tiles; they have no model of their own.
why.zh: 仪表板只显示磁贴，本身没有模型。

why.en: Report Builder authors paginated reports on an existing model.
why.zh: 报表生成器用于基于现有模型制作分页报表。

why.en: Mobile is for viewing, not authoring.
why.zh: 移动版只用来查看，不能制作。

q.en: Several free-licence users must view reports in a workspace without buying Pro. What works?
q.zh: 多位免费授权用户需要查看某个工作区的报表，但不购买 Pro。怎么做可行？

html.en: Share the report from My workspace
html.zh: 从「我的工作区」分享报表

why.en: Sharing still needs Pro unless the content is in a capacity.
why.zh: 除非内容在容量中，分享仍然需要 Pro。

html.en: Export the report to PDF every day
html.zh: 每天把报表导出成 PDF

why.en: That avoids Power BI rather than solving access.
why.zh: 这是绕开 Power BI，而不是解决访问问题。

why.en: A workspace role does not replace the licence requirement.
why.zh: 工作区角色不能代替授权要求。

html.en: Assign the workspace to a Fabric F64 (or Premium) capacity
html.zh: 把工作区分配到 Fabric F64（或 Premium）容量

why.en: Right: content in such a capacity can be viewed with a free licence.
why.zh: 对：位于这类容量中的内容，免费授权也能查看。

heading.zh: 数据分析师的工作流程

takeaways.en: The work runs in one direction: get data → transform → model → visualize → publish and share.
takeaways.zh: 工作按一个方向进行：获取数据 → 转换 → 建模 → 可视化 → 发布与分享。

takeaways.en: Power Query (M language) shapes the data; DAX calculates on the model; the report canvas shows it.
takeaways.zh: Power Query（M 语言）整理数据；DAX 在模型上做计算；报表画布负责呈现。

takeaways.en: Fix data problems as early (upstream) as possible: in the source, then Power Query, and only then DAX.
takeaways.zh: 数据问题要尽量在上游解决：先在数据源，其次在 Power Query，最后才用 DAX。

html.en: Every Power BI project goes through the same stages, and the four exam domains follow them in order.
html.zh: 每个 Power BI 项目都经过同样的阶段，考试的四个领域也按这个顺序排列。

items.en: Get data — connect to files, databases, cloud services or an existing semantic model.
items.zh: 获取数据——连接文件、数据库、云服务或现有的语义模型。

items.en: Transform — profile and clean the data and shape it into fact and dimension tables in the Power Query Editor.
items.zh: 转换——在 Power Query 编辑器中分析和清理数据，整理成事实表和维度表。

items.en: Model — create relationships, a date table, and DAX measures in the Model and Table views.
items.zh: 建模——在模型视图和表视图中建立关系、日期表和 DAX 度量值。

items.en: Visualize and analyze — design report pages, add interactions and use AI features to find patterns.
items.zh: 可视化与分析——设计报表页面、加入交互，并用 AI 功能寻找规律。

items.en: Publish, share and secure — publish to a workspace, set refresh, distribute with an app, apply row-level security.
items.zh: 发布、分享与保护——发布到工作区、设置刷新、用应用分发、套用行级别安全性。

rows.en: At refresh, before data is loaded
rows.zh: 刷新时，在数据载入之前

rows.en: At refresh, stored in the model
rows.zh: 刷新时计算，并存储在模型中

rows.en: At query time, for each visual and filter
rows.zh: 查询时，针对每个视觉对象和筛选条件计算

html.en: Roche's maxim, often quoted in Microsoft guidance: transform data as far upstream as possible, and as far downstream as necessary.
html.zh: Microsoft 指南常引用的「Roche 准则」：数据转换要尽量往上游做，必要时才往下游做。

q.en: A column must be cleaned (trim spaces, fix case) before it is used anywhere. Where is the best place to do it in Power BI?
q.zh: 某列在使用前必须先清理（去掉空格、统一大小写）。在 Power BI 中最好在哪里做？

why.en: A filter hides rows; it does not clean them.
why.zh: 筛选器只隐藏行，不会清理数据。

why.en: Formatting changes how values look, not what they are.
why.zh: 格式只改变外观，不改变值本身。

why.en: Measures run per query; they cannot fix stored values.
why.zh: 度量值在查询时计算，无法修正存储的值。

html.zh: 在 Power Query 中，载入之前

why.en: Right: clean data once, upstream, so every table and measure gets the clean values.
why.zh: 对：在上游清理一次，所有表和度量值都会用到干净的值。
